description: Elections Commission - Notify the name of a member selected to the Eheliyagoda Pradesiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha) due to termination of party membership. It involves the electoral process under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, including the nomination and declaration of a new member. This falls directly under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
